name: Protect Closet Shelving — Item Mask
intent: Light protection: individual item masking where shelving is briefly wrapped/taped off for adjacent paint work. Use when painting baseboard or lower walls only.
doctrine: Derived from wood_shelving baseline × 0.5 level multiplier (setup 0.75 min/LF = 80 LF/hr, teardown 0.25 min/LF = 240 LF/hr). Obstruction is level-independent (1 min/LF = 60 LF/hr). See legacy closet-shelving-protection.js rates for source.
